reason: Lint only: 4 of the 11 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings are fixed, with no change in what the app does: TimetableRateChart's polyline memo lists stepSec and unitSec (2), LoopEdge's label-size effect lists label.unit, already in its key (1), and TimelineChart's view-floor effect reads the height through useEffectEvent instead of leaving it out (1). TimelineChart:159, an effect that measures after every render, stays a warning: no suppression, as a react-hooks suppression stops the compiler-based rules for the whole component. npm run lint fails above 75 warnings (was 79); the rule stays a warning until all its warnings are gone. #625 item 5.
